description:
Run the frozen isolated XOR cells on the prepared Ryzen 9 5900X and commit the current pre-change evidence.

## Background

The baseline includes 8, 9, 63, 64, and 65 words, deliberately offset slices, neighboring sizes, declared cache regimes, and selected-route provenance. Earlier exploratory receipts guide prioritization but do not replace this current baseline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed receipt contains raw samples, exact commands, frozen input identities, append-only execution log, runtime provenance, statistical summary, and acceptance interpretation for each isolated XOR cell.
- [hard] REQ-02: Output validation proves exact XOR semantics for aligned and offset cells, and the receipt distinguishes dispatch-inclusive public calls from resolved-function observations.
- [hard] REQ-03: Annotated release assembly and profiles attribute observed costs to dispatch, call overhead, instruction mix, spills, cache traffic, or bandwidth without claiming an unsearched optimum.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
title: Record the isolated XOR baseline
